title.value: Parameterizing Branch-and-Bound Search Trees to Learn Branching Policies
title.justification: The title is explicitly stated at the very beginning of the paper, making it the formal title of the research paper.
title.quote: Parameterizing Branch-and-Bound Search Trees to Learn Branching Policies

analysis.description: This paper presents a framework for learning branching policies for Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP) problems that generalizes across heterogeneous instances. A novel imitation learning framework is proposed, introducing new input features and architectures to represent branching decisions. The framework's policies modulate branching decisions by incorporating the explicit parameterization of the state of the branch-and-bound search tree, improving accuracy and reducing tree sizes in computational experiments compared to state-of-the-art methods.
